# Idea Brief: Bilingual Gulf FIDIC claim pack for small contractors

- **Id:** 20261101-gulf-fidic-claim-pack
- **Category:** 10 Professional tooling and expertise products
- **Method playbook:** research/playbooks/gumroad-professional-template-pack.md
- **Date:** 2026-11-01

## What it is
A Gumroad download (Word + Excel, Arabic and English) with FIDIC 1999 and 2017
notice letters, a 20.1 / 20.2 time-bar tracker, a claim register and one worked
EOT example with Gulf amendments. Sold to planners and contract engineers at
small and mid GCC contractors, reached by personalised LinkedIn messages.

## Who pays, how much, how often
Planning or contracts engineer at a contractor without a claims department.
USD 49 one-off (price test USD 29-79). One purchase per firm; upsell to a
readiness review later.

| GCC contract awards | https://economymiddleeast.com/news/gcc-projects-pipeline-holds-at-2-05-trillion-despite-q3-slowdown | 2026-10-25 | trade press on Kamco data | USD 204.1B awarded in nine months of 2026; Qatar USD 5.2B in Q3 |

## Why it works now
Ashghal re-awarded eight delayed projects in October 2026; delayed and
re-baselined projects generate notices and claims. No Arabic EOT template pack
was found in the research pass; English generic packs are free or under USD 15.

## What would kill it
- A free bilingual pack from a consultancy as lead magnet
- Buyers wanting legal sign-off the studio cannot give
- Gumroad changing payout rules for Qatar

## Platform and payout check (from research/platform-rules.md and management/payments.md)
- Platform usable by a Qatar-resident seller: yes (Gumroad, bank payout in QAR)
- Payout route: Gumroad
- Published volume caps and disclosure duties that apply: none; state "not legal advice" on the listing

## Time
- Time to first dollar (typical, from evidence): 2-4 weeks with direct outreach (no distribution data; anchor is service-style selling)
- Monthly range at 6 months (typical small operator, from evidence; name the median if known): USD 100 - 600 (no median exists; Softedemy sells utilities at USD 15-90)

## Distribution
Channel 1: 50 personalised LinkedIn messages to planning engineers at GCC contractors (list in output/). Channel 2: Arabic P6 YouTube and Telegram groups with a free one-page sample.
